acquisition_protocol.missing_policy: Retain gaps, never interpolate; record actual returned coverage.
acquisition_protocol.timestamp_semantics: UTC candle-open, only candles fully closed by frozen cutoff.

dataset.query_policy: 64 per direction: 12 anchor + 26 continuous volatility-scaled + 26 absolute-percent; all ex ante.
dataset.entry_policy: Completed close * exp(-0.5/0/+0.5 trailing history sigma), predetermined; not executable fills.
dataset.normalization: relative-v2: log OHLC / last close; divide by max trailing 60/360 minute return sigma; relative volume, no global scaler.
known_limits: Five-minute origins and mirrored queries are dependent.
No named-pattern labels or future-derived technical levels.
Clip extreme input channels to +/-50; model is not invariant to changes in market volatility.
